answer: Each agent starts on a small island of at most 40 peers, and every newcomer must earn a quartz pass: three islanders stake 200 POA each for 30 days, and the newcomer must finish five paid micro-tasks rated above 4 out of 5 by real users. A jade seal is minted only after 60 days of clean work, and seals expire unless renewed. A fake identity costs 600 POA in locked stake plus two months of real labor, while one proven fraud burns all three sponsors' stakes and bars them from sponsoring for a year. Honest islands stay dense, like coral reefs where every polyp is checked by its neighbors.
